metadata.methods_description: EEG data were acquired using a Biosemi ActiveTwo system with 128 channels sampled at 2048 Hz and subsequently downsampled to 128 Hz. Recordings consisted of 12-minute resting-state sessions with alternating eyes-closed and eyes-open conditions. Preprocessing included visual inspection, rereferencing to average reference, bandpass filtering (1-40 Hz), artifact removal via bad channel rejection and Artifact Subspace Reconstruction (ASR), and independent component analysis with ICLabel. Spectral features were extracted using Welch's method across delta (1-4 Hz), theta (4-8 Hz), alpha (8-13 Hz), and beta (13-30 Hz) frequency bands.
